title: Building the Child’s Relationship with 'Ibadat (7–9 Years)
description: A tarbiyah path that helps parents instil the love of 'ibadat in the hearts of their children (7–9 years) through love and encouragement, not compulsion, while understanding the nature of this age.

primary_reference.info: تربية الأولاد في الإسلام لعبد الله ناصح علوان

review_defects.why: Inconsistent transliteration: title uses 'Ibadat (capital I), description uses 'ibadat (lowercase i). Should be uniform.
Arabic uses the adjective 'tarbawi' (educational), not the noun 'tarbiyah'. The translation 'tarbiyah path' alters the meaning slightly and is not a direct rendering.
